notes.test-only:src/lib/legacyCrypto.ts: Deliberate fail-closed tombstone, not an oversight. The module header says DO NOT USE and every export throws LegacyCryptoError; it exists so that an import of the removed pure-JS crypto primitives fails loudly instead of silently falling back. Keeping it and keeping its tests is the point -- deleting it would restore nothing and remove the marker. Revisit only if a migration build no longer needs the import to resolve.
